triggers.description: A candidate specification or objective needs a complete executable specification.
Only explicit bypass of full specification governance.
Revise an exact existing plan identity.
A live semantic choice about a boundary, representation, or owner.
Explicit EPG output or stored EPG work.

routes.description: Revise the same plan identity; EPG only when requested.
Encode and validate an explicitly requested export.
Report exact authority, evidence, completeness, or export obstruction.

required_artifacts: one complete execution specification on successful synthesis
success_signals: bare invocation governs and emits human output
direct is explicit
revision preserves identity for the same objective
bounded specification operations do not claim a complete execution plan
clauses.rationale: Mode, authority, output, and bounded inspection are distinct.

required_artifacts: self-contained proposed_plan block for human and both
success_signals: fresh session can execute from block and repository alone
each material choice is owned or observation-conditioned
human output has no hidden EPG or Ledger requirement
failure_signals: missing target, intended change, dependency, proof, or failure route
clauses.rationale: The primary artifact is the execution source, not an IR summary.

required_artifacts: fixed requirements and selected means distinguished
success_signals: repository establishes facts and existing obligations
selected mechanisms remain revisable inside authority
required-valid behavior survives domain restriction
failure_signals: plan acceptance silently locks all mechanisms
weakened requirement presented as simpler construction
clauses.rationale: Preserve required outcomes without freezing proposed means.

required_artifacts: family, valid domain, enforcement, independent coverage, discriminator, claim strength for consequential construction
success_signals: proof obligations chosen before implementation
migration and retirement derived with realization
branch uses evidence actually produced on that branch
clauses.rationale: Plan prepares discriminating proof; execution establishes it on actual code.

success_signals: material defects drive uncapped affected refinement
equivalent challenges reused
radical candidate dispositioned
final reread checks the exact block
clauses.rationale: Intellectual pressure does not require procedural reenactment.

required_artifacts: EPG-v1 with embedded exact specification and source digest
exact-byte native export validation and graph check
success_signals: json is raw JSON only
both embeds the same primary block without circular export digests
legacy validator and custody preserved
new exports require owners, effect boundaries, rollback, retirement, acyclic prerequisites, and owning seams
failure_signals: Ledger structural validity claimed as semantic proof
one serialization validated and another emitted
clauses.rationale: Strict new-export admission must not make EPG compulsory or break historical custody.

instrumentation.rationale: The execution specification is primary; machine validation applies only to explicit export and grants no authority.
